Definition: Share of submitted requests that include all required information at first review.
Calculation: Complete at first review / all requests submitted x 100

Definition: Business time from submission to first triage decision.
Calculation: Median business hours from submission to triage decision
Data Source: Created timestamp and triage decision timestamp
Proposed Target / Note: Proposed target <= 3 business days for complete requests

Definition: Business time from Awaiting Approval to recorded decision.
Calculation: Median business hours from approval entry to decision date

Definition: Share of tasks completed by their due date among tasks due in period.
Calculation: On-time completed tasks / tasks due in period x 100

Definition: Average number of follow-up cycles needed to complete intake.
Calculation: Total clarification cycles / requests needing clarification
Data Source: Request comments or a structured count field

Definition: Number of open requests older than the agreed age threshold.
Calculation: Count of open requests older than threshold

Definition: Share of assigned pilot users who complete required sessions or equivalent practice.
Difference between post-training and pre-training confidence score.
Calculation: Mean post score minus mean pre score on same scale
Proposed Target / Note: Report sample size and response rate

Definition: Share of workflow events requiring manual correction due to rule behavior.
Calculation: Manual rule corrections / applicable workflow events x 100

Definition: Share of required readiness checks with a recorded disposition before go/no-go.
Calculation: Checks with recorded disposition / required checks x 100
